module Divulgence where

import Daml.Script
import Iou

template DivulgeIouByExercise
  with
    payer: Party
    divulgee: Party
  where
    signatory divulgee
    observer payer

    nonconsuming choice Divulge : ()
      with ref : ContractId Iou
      controller payer
        do
          iou <- fetch ref
          return  ()

    nonconsuming choice ImmediateDivulgeIou : ContractId Iou
      controller payer
        do
          create Iou with payer = payer; owner = payer; amount = Amount {value = 100.0; currency = "USD"}; viewers = []

    nonconsuming choice RetroactiveArchivalDivulgeIou : ()
      with ref : ContractId Iou
      controller payer
        do
          archive ref

    nonconsuming choice NotDivulge : ()
      with ref : ContractId Iou
      controller payer
        do
          return ()

    choice ConsumeSelf: ()
      with
        actor: Party
      controller actor
      do
        pure ()

aliceDivulgesHerIouToBob =
  script do
    bank <- allocateParty "Bank"
    bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
    alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
    iou <- submit bank do
        createCmd $ Iou { payer = bank; owner = alice; amount = Amount {value = 1.0; currency = "USD"}; viewers = [] }
    req <- submit bob do
        createCmd $ DivulgeIouByExercise with payer = bank; divulgee = bob
    submit bank do exerciseCmd req NotDivulge with ref = iou
    submit bank do exerciseCmd req Divulge with ref = iou

module Divulgence where

import Daml.Script
import Iou

testAmountAndIssuance = script do
  payer <- allocateParty "amountPayer"
  owner <- allocateParty "amountOwner"
  viewer <- allocateParty "amountViewer"
  outsider <- allocateParty "amountOutsider"
  let amount = Amount {value = 12.50; currency = "EUR"}
  assert (amountAsText amount == "12.5EUR")
  submitMustFail owner do
    createCmd Iou with payer; owner; amount; viewers = [viewer]
  submitMustFail payer do
    createCmd Iou with payer; owner; amount = Amount {value = -0.01; currency = "EUR"}; viewers = []
  iouId <- submit payer do
    createCmd Iou with payer; owner; amount; viewers = [viewer]
  Some payerIou <- queryContractId payer iouId
  Some ownerIou <- queryContractId owner iouId
  Some viewerIou <- queryContractId viewer iouId
  None <- queryContractId outsider iouId
  assert (payerIou.amount == amount)
  assert (ownerIou.owner == owner && ownerIou.payer == payer)
  assert (viewerIou.viewers == [viewer])
  zeroId <- submit payer do
    createCmd Iou with payer; owner; amount = Amount {value = 0.0; currency = "USD"}; viewers = []
  Some zeroIou <- queryContractId owner zeroId
  assert (zeroIou.amount.value == 0.0)

testCall = script do
  payer <- allocateParty "callPayer"
  owner <- allocateParty "callOwner"
  viewer <- allocateParty "callViewer"
  let amount = Amount {value = 73.25; currency = "GBP"}
  iouId <- submit payer do
    createCmd Iou with payer; owner; amount; viewers = [viewer]
  submitMustFail payer do exerciseCmd iouId Call
  submitMustFail viewer do exerciseCmd iouId Call
  cashId <- submit owner do exerciseCmd iouId Call
  None <- queryContractId payer iouId
  Some cash <- queryContractId owner cashId
  assert (cash.payer == payer && cash.owner == owner && cash.amount == amount)
  Some _ <- queryContractId payer cashId
  None <- queryContractId viewer cashId
  submitMustFail owner do exerciseCmd iouId Call

testTransfer = script do
  payer <- allocateParty "transferPayer"
  owner <- allocateParty "transferOwner"
  recipient <- allocateParty "transferRecipient"
  viewer <- allocateParty "transferViewer"
  let amount = Amount {value = 42.0; currency = "CHF"}
  iouId <- submit payer do
    createCmd Iou with payer; owner; amount; viewers = [viewer]
  submitMustFail payer do exerciseCmd iouId Transfer with newOwner = recipient
  submitMustFail viewer do exerciseCmd iouId Transfer with newOwner = recipient
  submitMustFail recipient do exerciseCmd iouId Transfer with newOwner = recipient
  transferredId <- submit owner do exerciseCmd iouId Transfer with newOwner = recipient
  None <- queryContractId owner iouId
  Some transferred <- queryContractId recipient transferredId
  assert (transferred.payer == payer && transferred.owner == recipient)
  assert (transferred.amount == amount && transferred.viewers == [])
  Some _ <- queryContractId payer transferredId
  None <- queryContractId owner transferredId
  None <- queryContractId viewer transferredId
  submitMustFail owner do exerciseCmd transferredId Call
  submitMustFail owner do exerciseCmd transferredId Transfer with newOwner = owner
  cashId <- submit recipient do exerciseCmd transferredId Call
  Some cash <- queryContractId payer cashId
  assert (cash.owner == recipient && cash.amount == amount)

testShare = script do
  payer <- allocateParty "sharePayer"
  owner <- allocateParty "shareOwner"
  firstViewer <- allocateParty "shareFirstViewer"
  secondViewer <- allocateParty "shareSecondViewer"
  let amount = Amount {value = 8.0; currency = "JPY"}
  iouId <- submit payer do
    createCmd Iou with payer; owner; amount; viewers = []
  None <- queryContractId firstViewer iouId
  submitMustFail payer do exerciseCmd iouId Share with viewer = firstViewer
  submitMustFail firstViewer do exerciseCmd iouId Share with viewer = firstViewer
  sharedId <- submit owner do exerciseCmd iouId Share with viewer = firstViewer
  None <- queryContractId firstViewer iouId
  Some shared <- queryContractId firstViewer sharedId
  assert (shared.payer == payer && shared.owner == owner)
  assert (shared.amount == amount && shared.viewers == [firstViewer])
  None <- queryContractId secondViewer sharedId
  submitMustFail firstViewer do exerciseCmd sharedId Share with viewer = secondViewer
  twiceSharedId <- submit owner do exerciseCmd sharedId Share with viewer = secondViewer
  Some twiceShared <- queryContractId secondViewer twiceSharedId
  assert (twiceShared.viewers == [secondViewer, firstViewer])
  Some _ <- queryContractId firstViewer twiceSharedId
  None <- queryContractId firstViewer sharedId
  submitMustFail firstViewer do exerciseCmd twiceSharedId Call
  cashId <- submit owner do exerciseCmd twiceSharedId Call
  Some cash <- queryContractId payer cashId
  assert (cash.amount == amount && cash.owner == owner)
  None <- queryContractId firstViewer cashId
  pure ()
